name: The Food We Eat
overview: Scripture reveals that God originally provided plants and fruits as food for humanity and animals alike, establishing a natural order for sustenance (Genesis 1:29-30). After the flood, God expanded this provision to include all living creatures as food (Genesis 9:3). While God gave specific dietary instructions through Moses (Leviticus 11:1), Jesus taught that what enters a person externally does not defile them, emphasizing spiritual purity over dietary restrictions (Mark 7:18). Ultimately, true life and sustenance come through faith in Christ, who offers everlasting life beyond physical nourishment (John 6:47).
